name: Hermes Agent v0.22.6: time-aware cron jobs, hermes cron cancel, and a pre_llm_call hook
title: Hermes Agent v0.22.6: time-aware cron jobs, hermes cron cancel, and a pre_llm_call hook
summary: Cron jobs now know the time they were scheduled for. hermes cron cancel stops a stuck run and keeps the schedule. A pre_llm_call hook can block a prompt before any model call. Update with hermes update; Hermes Cloud updates itself.

appearances.title: Hermes Agent 0.22.6 adds cron control and a pre-model hook
appearances.summary: Hermes Agent 0.22.6 makes a 07:00 cron job aware that the local time is 07:00, adds `hermes cron cancel` to stop a stuck run without deleting the schedule, and adds a pre_llm_call hook that can block a prompt before any model call. The CLI update command is `hermes update`. Hermes Cloud updates itself.
